videos.description:

videos.title: BIGGER Batteries in the New Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 and Watch 9
videos.description:
Alongside a new trio of Galaxy foldables, Samsung has also unveiled its Galaxy smartwatches with larger batteries at its Unpacked launch event in London.

The Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 has an 800mAh battery, 35% larger than the 590mAh battery in the original Ultra smartwatch released in 2024. The regular Galaxy Watch 9, which comes in 40mm and 44mm sizes, also has a 20% larger 390mAh battery compared to the previous Galaxy Watch 8.

videos.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Hands-On: Shorter and Wider Is Actually Better
videos.description:
At Samsung’s July Galaxy Unpacked event, the company announced the Z Fold 8. Since Samsung’s original Galaxy Fold released in 2019, Samsung has steadily widened its book-style foldables so that they feel more like standard bar phones than a tall and skinny TV remote. The Z Fold 8 is the first time Samsung is switching up the aspect ratio so that the device is shorter and wider when closed, which also means it’s equally so when unfolded into a mini-tablet.
